import os
import gc
import xgboost as xgb
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import time
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score

# Set random seeds for reproducibility
SEEDS = [42, 123, 456]
BASE_SEED = 42
np.random.seed(BASE_SEED)

# Disable progress bars
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Configuration
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
VAL_SPLIT = 0.2

# Best hyperparameters from previous solution
MAX_DEPTH = 8
LEARNING_RATE = 0.05
N_ESTIMATORS = 500
SUBSAMPLE = 0.8
MIN_CHILD_WEIGHT = 30
REG_ALPHA = 1.0
REG_LAMBDA = 1.0

# Create submission directory
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def main():
    start_time = time.time()

    # Load Data
    print("Loading data...")
    train_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv"))
    test_df = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv"))

    # Identify columns
    target_col = "target"
    id_col = "id"

    # Separate train features and target
    train_ids = train_df[id_col].values
    train_target = train_df[target_col].values
    train_features = train_df.drop(columns=[id_col, target_col])

    # Test data
    test_ids = test_df[id_col].values
    test_features = test_df.drop(columns=[id_col])

    # Feature Engineering - Add polynomial and interaction features
    print("Creating polynomial and interaction features...")
    continuous_cols = [
        "f_00",
        "f_01",
        "f_02",
        "f_03",
        "f_04",
        "f_05",
        "f_06",
        "f_19",
        "f_20",
        "f_21",
        "f_22",
        "f_23",
        "f_24",
        "f_25",
        "f_26",
        "f_28",
    ]

    for col in continuous_cols:
        train_features[f"{col}_sq"] = train_features[col] ** 2
        test_features[f"{col}_sq"] = test_features[col] ** 2

    for col in continuous_cols:
        if abs(train_features[col].max()) > 10:
            train_features[f"{col}_log"] = np.log(np.abs(train_features[col] + 1e-10))
            test_features[f"{col}_log"] = np.log(np.abs(test_features[col] + 1e-10))

    interaction_pairs = [
        ("f_28", "f_00"),
        ("f_28", "f_21"),
        ("f_28", "f_06"),
        ("f_21", "f_26"),
        ("f_00", "f_01"),
        ("f_20", "f_22"),
    ]
    for c1, c2 in interaction_pairs:
        train_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_int"] = train_features[c1] * train_features[c2]
        test_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_int"] = test_features[c1] * test_features[c2]

    # f_29 and f_30 interactions
    for c1, c2 in [("f_29", "f_30")]:
        train_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_interaction"] = (
            train_features[c1] * train_features[c2]
        )
        test_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_interaction"] = test_features[c1] * test_features[c2]
        train_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_sum"] = train_features[c1] + train_features[c2]
        test_features[f"{c1}_{c2}_sum"] = test_features[c1] + test_features[c2]

    drop_cols = ["f_27"]
    train_features = train_features.drop(columns=drop_cols, errors="ignore")
    test_features = test_features.drop(columns=drop_cols, errors="ignore")

    X_train = train_features.values.astype(np.float32)
    X_test = test_features.values.astype(np.float32)
    y_train = train_target.astype(np.float32)

    # Train-Validation Split (80-20)
    X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train, y_train, test_size=VAL_SPLIT, random_state=BASE_SEED
    )

    print(
        f"Shapes after split - Train: {X_train_split.shape}, Val: {X_val.shape}, Test: {X_test.shape}"
    )

    # Standardize features - fit on train split only
    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_train_split = scaler.fit_transform(X_train_split)
    X_val = scaler.transform(X_val)
    X_test = scaler.transform(X_test)

    print("Preprocessing done. Training 3 ensemble models...")

    # Train ensemble models
    all_val_preds = []
    all_test_preds = []

    for seed_idx, seed in enumerate(SEEDS):
        print(f"Training model {seed_idx + 1}/{len(SEEDS)} with seed {seed}...")

        model = xgb.XGBClassifier(
            n_estimators=N_ESTIMATORS,
            learning_rate=LEARNING_RATE,
            max_depth=MAX_DEPTH,
            subsample=SUBSAMPLE,
            colsample_bytree=0.8,
            reg_alpha=REG_ALPHA,
            reg_lambda=REG_LAMBDA,
            min_child_weight=MIN_CHILD_WEIGHT,
            random_state=seed,
            tree_method="hist",
            n_jobs=-1,
            early_stopping_rounds=30,
            verbose=0,
        )

        model.fit(
            X_train_split, y_train_split, eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)], verbose=False
        )

        val_pred = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
        test_pred = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

        all_val_preds.append(val_pred)
        all_test_preds.append(test_pred)

        gc.collect()

    # Average predictions across ensemble
    avg_val_preds = np.mean(all_val_preds, axis=0)
    avg_test_preds = np.mean(all_test_preds, axis=0)

    # Validation
    print("Evaluating on validation set...")
    auc_score = roc_auc_score(y_val, avg_val_preds)
    print(f"Validation AUC-ROC (Ensemble): {auc_score:.6f}")

    # Save Submission
    print("Generating submission...")
    submission_df = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": avg_test_preds})

    submission_path = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")
    submission_df.to_csv(submission_path, index=False)
    print(f"Submission saved to {submission_path}")

    # Final Time Check
    elapsed = time.time() - start_time
    print(f"Total time: {elapsed:.2f} seconds")
    print(f"Best validation AUC-ROC: {auc_score:.6f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
